snippet.title: Kritsana Official Trailer | 1997: VHS Tape #01 (Thai Psychological Horror Game)
snippet.description:
Thailand, 1997 🇹🇭📼

What if a psychiatric patient's hallucinations aren't just in his head?

Inspect retro CCTV footage, identify unsettling anomalies, and report them before 05:00 AM. But remember... some anomalies know they are being watched.

🚨 FREE PLAYABLE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW! (Approx. 10–15 mins)

Play the demo today and share your feedback to help us shape the full game!

🔗 Play the Demo: https://debuz.itch.io/kritsana
